description: Get the ranking list for a given week. Without `date` returns the latest snapshot; with `date` returns the snapshot in effect at that day. Each entry includes the ranking type, position, points, diffs against the previous snapshot (or against the snapshot in effect on `after_date` when given), `rated_matches` (rated matches in the 12 months before the snapshot), `gap_ranking` (position in the `gap_type` ranking in effect the same week) and `ranking_gap` (`gap_ranking` minus `ranking`). Types `official` and `race` are FIP points tables; type `elo` ranks players by Elo rating (carried in `points`) and only includes players with at least 5 rated matches in the last 12 months (a walkover or a bye never produces a rating); type `earnings` ranks players by prize money earned in the season (carried in `points`, currency in `currency`) and only includes players with earnings. Filter by ranking type, category (men/women), nationality (2-letter country code), age range and minimum rated matches. Sort by `ranking_diff`, `points_diff` or `ranking_gap`.

after_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the period over which `ranking_diff` and `points_diff` are measured, against the snapshot in effect on that day. Defaults to the previous weekly snapshot.

category.description: Filter by player category. Omit to return both.

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) for which the ranking is requested. Defaults to the latest available snapshot.

gap_type.description: Ranking type `gap_ranking` and `ranking_gap` compare against. Defaults to `official`, or to `elo` when `type` is `official`.

max_age.description: Maximum age of the players, in years.

min_age.description: Minimum age of the players, in years.

min_matches.description: Minimum number of rated matches played in the 12 months before the snapshot.

nationality.description: 2-letter country code to filter the players by nationality (e.g. `ES`, `AR`).

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results (e.g. 1 for the number one), or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the rankings by. `ranking_diff` and `points_diff` sort by the change since the previous snapshot or since `after_date`; `ranking_gap` by the difference against the `gap_type` ranking. Defaults to `ranking`.

type.description: Ranking type. Defaults to `official` when omitted.

name: list-rankings
